raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fix the GSM8K source directory in the three Ascend workflows that failed during dataset preprocessing on #8251. They currently pass `${HOME}/.cache/datasets/openai/gsm8k`, which resolves to `/root/.cache/datasets/openai/gsm8k` and raises `FileNotFoundError`.

Use the proposed runner cache path `/root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k` so the existing preprocessing steps can validate it on the NPU runners.

Affected failures:

- [e2e_ascend / LLM RL job](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/actions/runs/39397448201/job/118545925791)
- [e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2_ascend / FSDP vLLM job](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/actions/runs/39397448240/job/118545929465)
- [vllm_ascend](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/actions/runs/39397448294/job/118545936815)

This is a functional fix for three blocked CI jobs. Duplicate checks covered #8251's discussion and open PR searches for `8251 in:body`, `gsm8k ascend`, and `modelscope`; no open PR addressing this dataset-path failure was found. #8251 changes FSDP-Turbo and vLLM model handling and does not fix these workflow paths.

This change was prepared with AI assistance. NPU CI validation is pending.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. [Query: open GSM8K Ascend PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+gsm8k+ascend).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Parsed all three workflows with PyYAML and checked the preprocessing commands with `bash -n`: passed.
- Verified that all three preprocessing commands pass the requested absolute dataset path and each workflow includes itself in `pull_request.paths` for `main`: passed.
- `pre-commit run --files .github/workflows/e2e_ascend.yml .github/workflows/e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2_ascend.yml .github/workflows/vllm_ascend.yml --show-diff-on-failure`: passed; all applicable hooks passed, and Python-file lint/type hooks skipped because only YAML files changed.
- NPU execution and the contents of the proposed cache directory cannot be verified locally. The existing CI preprocessing steps are the runtime validation; subsequent training or rollout failures may have independent causes.

### API and Usage Example

No public API changes. The existing preprocessing commands use `--local_dataset_path /root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k`.

### Design & Code Changes

Change one dataset-source argument in each of `e2e_ascend.yml`, `e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2_ascend.yml`, and `vllm_ascend.yml`. The generated parquet output locations and CI triggers remain unchanged.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting) to the three changed workflows.
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs). Not applicable: CI runner path only.
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to the [CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. Existing preprocessing and end-to-end steps cover this change; no new tests are needed.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.
- [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, update its reference. Not applicable.

files.patch:
@@ -115,7 +115,7 @@ jobs:
           uv pip list
       - name: Preprocess gsm8k dataset
         run: |
-          python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path ${HOME}/.cache/datasets/openai/gsm8k
+          python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path /root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k
       - name: Running gsm8k e2e training tests with PPO on ASCEND NPU (FSDP backend)
         run: |
           ray stop --force

@@ -119,7 +119,7 @@ jobs:
           ln -s /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models ~/models
       - name: Prepare GSM8K dataset
         run: |
-          python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path ${HOME}/.cache/datasets/openai/gsm8k
+          python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path /root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k
       # Function RM
       - name: Running GSM8K E2E training tests on 8 L20 GPUs with rmpad using function rm with validation and saving (DDP_SIZE=2, FSDP_SIZE=4)
         run: |

@@ -109,7 +109,7 @@ jobs:
       - name: Prepare gsm8k dataset
         run: |
           ray stop --force
-          python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path ${HOME}/.cache/datasets/openai/gsm8k --local_dir ${HOME}/data/gsm8k
+          python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_dataset_path /root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k --local_dir ${HOME}/data/gsm8k
       - name: Test the latest vLLM Rollout async with deterministic agent loop
         env:
           PYTHONHASHSEED: "0"
